rules.text: two-tier system applies from 2019-10-30, exempt tier 6 x minimum reserves at 0% (press release 2019-09-12)
deposit facility rate raised to 0% from 2022-07-27, which makes the exempt tier redundant (two-tier system page)
multiplier set to 0 from the maintenance period starting 2022-09-14 (two-tier system page)
TLTRO III rate indexed to the average key rates from 2022-11-23, with added voluntary repayment dates (press release 2022-10-27)
minimum reserves remunerated at the deposit facility rate from 2022-12-21 (press release 2022-10-27)
minimum reserves remunerated at 0% from 2023-09-20 (press release 2023-07-27)
spread between the MRO rate and the deposit facility rate cut from 50 to 15 basis points from 2024-09-18 (press release 2024-03-13)
